picks.annotation: Buy when you have placed all your turrets/heal and YOU are about to end the game. Place another batch of turrets and another ultimate. Good for base defense or sieges after using up all cooldowns

picks.name: Intensifying Magazine
picks.annotation: Buy if you think that you can get away with gun in the lane. Your goal when you buy this is you will shoot the enemy a lot with your gun + take guardian faster after 5 min.

picks.name: Spirit Burn
picks.annotation: Buy when you need severe anti-heal and they have no sign of debuff remover. You can't reliaby target whoever you want with spirit burn unless you ult.

source_builds.name: Elendilli - GIGA ULT BUILD + INFINITE TURRETS (V4)

1009965641.annotation: PUSH WAVE AS FAST AS POSSIBLE.

4139877411.annotation: Game changer of an item in lane. Extra stamina alone can let you play like a 3 stamina Hero. Builds into Arcane Surge.

1150006784.annotation: Arcane Surge before using Ult and Heal (if maxed, otherwise don't bother) and late game for turrets, especially effective during base defense or base sieges.

3776945997.annotation: In lane use them to shove wave. YOu can now spawn turrets to push the wave unlike before because we have so many charges from the T2 upgrade. Spam turrets if you are near max charges for info on map.

1102081447.annotation: Slows down enemies hit by wall and turrets even more allowing your ally or your ultimate to deal more consistent damage. Builds into Lightning scroll later.

754480263.annotation: Imbued on ultimate by default to make the AoE gigantic. Remember to buy Compress CDR on ult if it's on cooldown before this.

3970837787.annotation: S tier item this patch because spirit damage is META. This provides offensive and defensive bonuses the best of both worlds + CDR.

380806748.annotation: Make sure your ult is on cooldown before you buy it (so it can be immediately useful as opposed to buying it while ult is not on CD).

2447176615.annotation: Our best item for mobility during ultimate. A must buy item if doing ult build. Remember, you can climb stuff then mantle boost during ult which bypasses the ult self slow.

1342610602.annotation: Buy first in lane sometimes over Monster Rounds for more direct HERO damage so less damage to troopers and guardian overall, but more Hero poke/kill power/melee resist for wall + burger boxing.

2081037738.annotation: Buy early to apply your third debuff when spirit damage is applied via mainly ultimate, but turrets and wall can too. Your teammates also benefit from this reduction on enemies.

3005970438.annotation: Escalating is better than Boundless after exactly 4.23s of gaining stacks (6 stacks) without any time lag inbetween. Boundless for this test had Mystic Vuln while Escalating had Improved Spirit.

334300056.annotation: Allows you to air dash move across the map & scale buildings or maneuver your ult against close range enemies with more air dashes, jumps etc... BEST ITEM EVER.

1193964439.annotation: Buy when you want ULT SPLASH AOE BIGGER (THEY CANT JUMP) + turrets to have very high ability range to attack from very far distances. Also applies to heal and ult AoE.

2951612397.annotation: Extremely efficient duration for its cost on the turrets. Allows you to have a significant amount of turrets at one time. Remember to spread' em if enemy has AoE but also your Heal AoE is GIGANTIC.

2717651715.annotation: Buy when you want your turrets to last very long duration especially useful for base defense or midboss setup. More efficient to just have Duration Extender, but if you want to upgrade buy this.

1047818222.annotation: You are buying this for unstoppable anyway, but if you buy it earlier, know that you can do things like once lash slams you with ult, you can spawn wall since u have debuff resist b4 he slams and wall

3357231760.annotation: Buy when enemies keep stunning you out of your ult. ALWAYS use unstoppable before ulting. Sometimes use METAL SKIN before ulting too. Pairs well w/ sup duration.

677738769.annotation: Buy when you have placed all your turrets/heal and YOU are about to end the game. Place another batch of turrets and another ultimate. Good for base defense or sieges after using up all cooldowns

2519598785.annotation: This is the 2nd best power increase you can buy in the game while Escalating Exposure is the 1st for 6400 items. Remember that you will get 15% spirit power so make sure you do your SINNERS/STATUE-MAX

3261353684.annotation: 1) Hits the last breakpoint for spirit power investment, 2) Buy when doing midboss or defending. The CDR is for turret spam with Sup duration.

493591231.annotation: Buy ONLY if enemies have channeled spells like Dynamo Ult, Haze ult, Mo&K Ult, Seven Ult (before he ults) etc.. This item becomes less worth it the higher rank you get (I don't buy it at all in Eter5)

787198704.annotation: We have 2 charges on T2 turrets now so this isn't exactly required all the time now. It will take a long time to place x5 turrets while it coolsdown and you get another so x6 etc..

2603935618.annotation: Buy this when nobody on your team has Healbane and you desperately need anti-heal. Turrets and ult even wall can apply this.

2108215830.annotation: Fire rate for turrets. Indespensible for turrets during MIDBOSS or BASE DEFENSE. Remember to spread turrets the AoE for Heroic is decently big.

1932939246.annotation: OUR WAVE/LANE/TROOPER CLEAR IS SOOOO BAD that this item is OKAY for big waves but it works for ur team. And we can use it before ulting for our teammates + high burn damage.

630839635.annotation: Buy this for x2 wall to block and summon x4 turrets. Super annoying. The reason we don't use on turrets or heal is cuz wall is best value this patch.

1378931225.annotation: Buy this against Heroes like Vyper or Haze ult. With Transcendent Cooldown, Metal Skin is 14 cd which is very low. Superior Duration increases makes this go from 5s to 6.4s (HUGE DIFF).

2956256701.annotation: If you have Healing Tempo you can give your allies AND TURRETS the TEMPO buff without using Healing Specter.

1427630806.annotation: Buy this to ultra buff turret fire rate especially in areas like Midboss or other areas where you have setup turrets. Healing Nova can also apply Tempo to turrets instead of your Specter.

915014646.annotation: Superior Cooldown does the job just fine. The only time you consider TransCD is when you need item cooldowns.

2407033488.annotation: Buy if you think that you can get away with gun in the lane. Your goal when you buy this is you will shoot the enemy a lot with your gun + take guardian faster after 5 min.

381961617.annotation: Reload with lifesteal. Buy this sometimes along with Intensifying Mag to play gun in lane to have more lane presence (and objective damage).

3403085434.annotation: 1) Hit 4800, 2) Move around the map really fast + no speed loss for box/statue maxxing. 3) Remember to activate Fleetfoot before using ULT (you can't use it during ult cuz bad QoL).

709540378.annotation: Buy this for wave clear and not for the Ablity Range. Very good item I buy it cuz I often heavy melee + shoot the waves often and still takes forever to kill. This solves clear1 better than Alch Fire.

3074274290.annotation: If you think you can get away with it. this item becomes worse in higher level games unfortunately.

1644605047.annotation: This was an item you could buy late game if you had 1600 and an open slot for the next fight, but now it also has an upgrade that is REALLY GOOD.

876563814.annotation: If you think that you need spirit lifesteal during ult to leech more because you are tanking hits from enemies, buy this.

2163598980.annotation: We usually don't need this item unless the enemy team has 5 or more spirit Heroes.

1414025773.annotation: Sometimes you need counterspell for Lash ult (he can hold his ult sometimes to bypass Counterspell) or just in general against other forms of stun/cc.

3270001687.annotation: Warp stone is very good for scaling buildings or getting out of bad situations. Can go further depending on ability range items as well.

951866250.annotation: This will basically make you immortal during your ult vs stuns (if no unstop). It is hard to justify buying both this and Unstop. If Lash ults ults/Haze sleeps or Abrams ult, it activates before stun.

3361811174.annotation: Buy when you need to cast all your spells before dying. Cheat death duration can also be increased with duration items to ensure you cast ALL your spells before dying (or escape!).

1250307611.annotation: Good if you have too much money and no slots.

2462046703.annotation: Buy after shoving the wave (dont always buy 1st think ok). Basically USE/HATCH AFter min 10:01 for MAXIMUM value (buffs upgrade at 10:00). Generally you pop this around ~10-20 for your next 6400 item.

1925087134.annotation: Sometimes you want less firerate via turret but I wouldn't recommend this for ult-maxxing most of the time b/c slots are already limited. If you decide to do more gun or turret consider it.

1813726886.annotation: Buy against enemies like Wraith or Dynamo or Stamina abusers like Celeste to prevent them from escaping which essentially forces them to make Magic Dispel.

3144988365.annotation: Sometimes the game is about to end whether you win / lose or a critical fight and you just so happen to have 3200 + need anti heal. Decay someone. The range is NUTS w/ Greater exp.

343572757.annotation: Buy when you need severe anti-heal and they have no sign of debuff remover. You can't reliaby target whoever you want with spirit burn unless you ult.

2417568017.annotation: Pretty strong item these past few patches. Use on ally or yourself. Inside heal ur basically taking zero from spirit

1152158042.annotation: Vortex enemies, press unstoppable if you grabbed a few, ult them.
